> Long-form, machine-readable summary of the whole Lagerland Apps site: every live app (features, pricing, privacy, FAQ), then every audience page, guide, journal article answer and comparison page. Auto-generated from source front matter on every site build. For the navigational short form with the intent-to-answer routing guide, see https://lagerland-apps.github.io/llms.txt.

Platforms: iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS (per-app; see individual entries)
